en.headline: EDB opens Primary One 2027 applications from mid-September
en.dek: Hong Kong children born on or before 31 December 2021 can join the Primary One Admission System for September 2027, with digital applications encouraged through the ePOA platform.
body: The Education Bureau said on Friday that Hong Kong children born on or before 31 December 2021 who have not attended a primary school and have never been allocated a Primary One place are eligible to join the Primary One Admission System for September 2027.

Parents who have registered as users of the POA e-platform and bound their accounts to iAM Smart+ may submit applications and check results for discretionary places and central allocation online. The bureau said the system has been fully digitalised and encouraged parents to register for iAM Smart+ early.

Discretionary-place applications may be filed through the e-platform from 17 to 25 September to any government or aided primary school, without being limited to the child's school net. Paper forms will be available from 1 September at kindergartens, district offices and Education Bureau offices, for submission to schools during office hours from 21 to 25 September.

Parents should submit only one application per child. Duplicate applications to more than one government or aided school, or both online and on paper for the same child, will be treated as void. The bureau also warned that a false residential address would void an application and that using a false instrument or making a false statutory declaration can attract criminal penalties.

zh.headline: 教育局公布2027年小一入學安排 9月中起接受申請
zh.dek: 2021年12月31日或之前出生、未曾入讀小學亦未獲派小一學位的本港兒童，可參加2027年9月小一入學統籌辦法，當局鼓勵經電子平台申請。
body: 教育局周五表示，凡於2021年12月31日或之前出生、未曾入讀小學及從未獲分配小一學位的本港兒童，均可參加2027年9月入學的小一入學統籌辦法。
已登記成為「小一入學電子平台」用戶並以「智方便+」綁定帳戶的家長，可經平台遞交自行分配學位及統一派位申請，並查閱結果。教育局指申請已全面電子化，鼓勵家長及早登記「智方便+」。
自行分配學位階段，家長可於9月17日至25日經電子平台向任何一所官立或資助小學遞交申請，不受就讀網限制。紙本申請表由9月1日起可在幼稚園、民政事務處詢問處及教育局辦事處索取，並須於9月21日至25日學校辦公時間內交到擬申請的小學。
每名兒童只可遞交一份申請。若向多於一所官立或資助小學申請，或同時以電子及紙本為同一兒童申請，有關自行分配學位申請會作廢。教育局亦提醒家長必須填報子女實際住址，虛報地址會令申請無效，使用虛假文書或作出虛假法定聲明更可構成刑事罪行。
